capabilities: Add left-panel buttons that open chosen notes, folders paths, and canvases
Assign each button an icon from a searchable icon list
Set per-button keyboard shortcuts that override conflicting Obsidian hotkeys
Reorder and delete buttons via drag and drop
Keep shortcuts following notes when they are renamed or moved inside Obsidian
extras: README states the plugin and its documentation were AI-written ('vibecoded' with Claude Code). Installation is also possible via BRAT. It notes that removing buttons uses an internal Obsidian API method because the public API lacks one, and that renames made outside Obsidian are not tracked.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pin specific notes to the ribbon as one-click buttons with custom icons and per-note shortcuts.
summary: Ribbon button manager that opens chosen notes from the left panel, each with its own icon and optional keyboard shortcut.
